summary: BlackRock Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of Philip Tseng as Trustee, Board Chair, CEO, and Co-Chief Investment Officer, effective August 31, 2026, to pursue other opportunities. The resignation was not due to any disagreement. Jason Mehring, previously President, was appointed as Trustee, Board Chair, and CEO effective September 2, 2026, also for affiliates BDLC and TCPC. Mehring is a Managing Director with 30 years of experience. Tseng remains an employee through October 1, 2026, to ensure a smooth transition. No financial terms were disclosed. Watch for any subsequent strategic or leadership impacts on the fund's operations.
